name: sparkforge
description: SparkForge brand reference for AI design tools (v0, Subframe, Onlook). Reference, not restriction — see src/registry/README.md.

items.name: design-brief
items.title: SparkForge Design Brief
items.description: Read this first. Three-lane philosophy: Core/Preserve, Current/Open-to-redesign, Reference signals. The brief explicitly invites tools to reimagine anything outside the brand-DNA lane.

items.name: tokens
items.title: SparkForge Design Tokens
items.description: CSS custom properties for the eye-extracted brand-surface palette and the 11 lab identity colors (OKLCH-balanced). Tokens are reference defaults, not laws — replace freely if a redesign needs a different palette, just keep the lab-color identity mapping intact.

items.name: brand
items.title: SparkForge Brand Reference
items.description: Typed re-exports of the canonical lab table, audience signals (kids 7-16, parent-buyer), tier metadata, and the list of irreplaceable WebGPU+TSL 3D primitives that design tools should compose AROUND, not recreate.

items.name: brand-hero-slot
items.title: Brand Hero Slot
items.description: Drop-in for the dichroic SparkForge wordmark hero (WebGPU + TSL with MP4 fallback). Use as the centerpiece of any marketing landing redesign — compose chrome, tagline, CTAs around it; do not try to recreate the 3D in HTML.

items.name: cockpit-preview-slot
items.title: Cockpit Preview Slot
items.description: Drop-in mini cockpit dashboard scene (~50K tris) for marketing / pricing pages. Wraps its own R3F Canvas, fills its container. Use to give marketing visitors a taste of the product before signup.

items.name: login-panel-slot
items.title: Login Panel Slot
items.description: Drop-in for the 3D auth panel. Owns email/password/OAuth/demo flow internally, including the audit-fixed accessibility and password-manager autofill bridges. Compose backgrounds and chrome around it; do not recreate the form.
